identity.evidence: The published logo file is byte-identical (SHA-256 verified 2026-11-27) to the Wise mark file distributed by Simple Icons at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/develop/icons/wise.svg — the documented source of this published file (web/assets/logos/README.md lists 'wise' among the Simple Icons files used for startup logos). Wise's official website (https://wise.com/) publishes the same mark as its JSON-LD logo (https://wise.com/public-resources/assets/logos/wise-personal/logo.png), confirming the glyph is Wise's own brand mark.
